categories.main_business_segments: Cambricon Technologies Corporation Limited focuses on the research, design, and sales of artificial intelligence (AI) core chips used in cloud servers, edge computing devices, and terminal devices. Its main product lines include cloud AI chips and acceleration cards, training machines, edge AI chips and acceleration cards, terminal AI processor IP, and supporting basic system software. Additionally, the company offers intelligent computing cluster systems integrating its hardware with partner-provided servers, networks, and storage for AI applications in data centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced AI chip technologies including self-developed intelligent processor microarchitecture and instruction sets, SoC chip design, chip packaging and testing, and hardware system design. It also develops a unified platform-level basic system software supporting cloud-edge-terminal AI chips, including programming frameworks, compilers, mathematical libraries, virtualization software, and integrated development environments. Manufacturing is outsourced under a fabless model, with wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing handled by specialized foundries and contractors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cambricon serves customers in internet, telecommunications operators, finance, energy, education, and other vertical industries. Its AI chips and acceleration cards are used in large-scale AI model training and inference, search engines, advertising recommendation systems, and intelligent transformation of traditional industries. Key customers include leading algorithm companies, major banks, telecom operators, and server manufacturers such as Inspur and Lenovo.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with 99.54% of revenue generated domestically. It has subsidiaries and operations in Beijing, Shanghai, Anhui, Xian, Nanjing, Suzhou, Taizhou, Hong Kong, and other Chinese cities. Hong Kong subsidiary uses RMB as its accounting currency. The company also engages with international partners and holds patents abroad.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cambricon operates as a fabless semiconductor company, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to foundries and contractors. It is positioned upstream in the AI chip design and IP development segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing core AI processing technology and hardware platforms to downstream customers such as server manufacturers and AI application companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment to maintain technological leadership in AI chips, focusing on next-generation intelligent processor microarchitecture and instruction sets optimized for large AI models. It advances unified software platforms for training and inference across cloud, edge, and terminal devices, enhancing performance, usability, and ecosystem development. Cambricon also emphasizes talent development, ecosystem building, and expanding market penetration in emerging AI application scenarios like generative AI and large language models.
categories.revenue_model: Cambricon generates revenue primarily through sales of AI chips, acceleration cards, training machines, and intelligent computing cluster systems. It also earns income from IP licensing and software platform services. The company mainly uses direct sales channels, with a small portion through distributors. Revenue recognition follows contract terms upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cambricon is a globally recognized emerging company in the AI chip sector, holding a leading position in China’s AI chip market. It competes with major semiconductor companies like Nvidia, which currently holds a dominant global market share. Cambricon differentiates itself through its comprehensive cloud-edge-terminal AI chip portfolio, proprietary instruction sets, and integrated software ecosystems. The company has received multiple industry awards and maintains strong technical and brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Cambricon reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 709 million, a slight decrease of 2.7% year-over-year, with a gross margin of 69.16%. The company remains unprofitable with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 848 million, though losses narrowed by 32.47% compared to the previous year. R&D expenses accounted for 157.53% of revenue, reflecting heavy investment. The company’s total assets reached RMB 6.42 billion, with net assets of RMB 5.65 billion, showing steady growth and a positive cash flow trend supported by successful equity financing.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cambricon emphasizes its leading core AI chip technologies, including self-developed processor architectures and instruction sets, enabling high-performance, energy-efficient AI computation across cloud, edge, and terminal devices. Its unified software platform breaks down development barriers across hardware types, facilitating rapid AI application deployment. The company’s products support diverse AI workloads such as vision, speech, natural language processing, and recommendation systems, providing customers with competitive computing power and a comprehensive ecosystem to accelerate AI innovation and industry digital transformation.
